rateLimits.note: CDS SIMBAD FAQ: SIMBAD queries limited to 10 a second from a single IP address; more than 10 in one second bans the IP for 1 minute.
CDS SIMBAD FAQ: more than 400 queries in 10 seconds bans the IP for 1 hour.

attribution.text: This research has made use of the SIMBAD database, CDS, Strasbourg Astronomical Observatory, France

provenance.notes: Every *.unistra.fr host (cds, simbad, vizier) refused or timed out on 2026-11-10 (ECONNREFUSED / timeout), so no CDS page could be read directly; the figures and the ODbL statement come from the search engine's excerpts of the CDS SIMBAD FAQ and a CDS SIMBAD page read that day. To re-read at the source. CDS legals ask datasets to be cited with the CDS service used ("CDS/SIMBAD"); the SIMBAD reference is Wenger et al. 2000, A&AS 143, 9; cite the original papers of each value. ODbL: derived databases that are made public must stay under ODbL (share-alike). Astroquery's docs give a looser "5 to 10 queries a second" (third party, not used).
